sentences.en: This is an iHeart Podcast, Guaranteed Human.
sentences.zh: 这是一个iHeart播客，保证真人录制。

sentences.en: I've been really trying to prioritize my health in a realistic way this year, and something that has kept me really motivated is my WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 今年我一直在以一种切合实际的方式优先关注自己的健康，而让我保持极高积极性的东西就是我的WHOOP手环。

sentences.en: I am such a data person, which is why I love WHOOP, because I can genuinely see why my body feels differently depending on the day, why I'm running differently,
sentences.zh: 我是一个非常看重数据的人，这就是为什么我热爱WHOOP，因为我能真切地看出为什么我的身体在不同日子里会有不同的感觉，为什么我跑步的状态会不一样，

sentences.en: why I'm maybe less focused.
sentences.zh: 为什么我可能注意力不太集中。

sentences.en: WHOOP effortlessly tracks my sleep, it tracks my strain, my recovery, my stress, and most importantly, my overall health.
sentences.zh: WHOOP能轻松追踪我的睡眠，追踪我的运动强度、恢复情况、压力水平，最重要的是，追踪我的整体健康状况。

sentences.en: And it just gives me all that data and all those patterns so I can make better decisions, which includes knowing when to go easy and knowing when to go hard.
sentences.zh: 它为我提供所有这些数据和规律，以便我能做出更好的决策，包括知道什么时候该放松，什么时候该加把劲。

sentences.en: New members can try WHOOP with a 30-day free trial before committing to a membership.
sentences.zh: 新会员在正式订阅之前，可以免费体验30天的WHOOP。

sentences.en: That's join.whoop.com slash psychology for your free month of WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 访问 join.whoop.com 斜杠 psychology，即可免费体验一个月的WHOOP。

sentences.en: Some people keep all their old gig tickets.
sentences.zh: 有些人保留着他们所有的旧演出门票。

sentences.en: It brings back the music, it brings back the memories, even the smells.
sentences.zh: 它能唤回音乐，唤回记忆，甚至连气味都能唤回。

sentences.en: Other people collect perfume bottles or coffee mugs or overseas banknotes, classic sweaters from the 80s.
sentences.zh: 其他人则收集香水瓶、咖啡杯、海外纸币，或是80年代的经典毛衣。

sentences.en: Collection is deeply personal.
sentences.zh: 收藏是一件极具个人色彩的事。

sentences.en: It says who we are, but it also says where we've come from.
sentences.zh: 它诉说着我们是谁，但也诉说着我们来自何方。

sentences.zh: 在全新播客《与萨姆·托德一起着迷》（Charmed with Sam Todd）中，

sentences.en: Sam explores the memories, obsessions, and tiny treasures that become part of who we are.
sentences.zh: 萨姆探索了那些构成我们一部分的记忆、执念和微小宝藏。

sentences.en: Charmed with Sam Todd.
sentences.zh: 《与萨姆·托德一起着迷》。

sentences.en: Stories want to tell with Pandora.
sentences.zh: 与Pandora合作打造的“想讲述的故事”。

sentences.zh: 现在就在iHeart上收听该播客。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody, and welcome back to the Psychology of Your 20s, the podcast where we talk through some of the big life changes and transitions of our 20s
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到《20多岁的心理学》，在这里我们探讨20多岁时的一些重大生活变化与转折，

sentences.en: and what they mean for our psychology.
sentences.zh: 以及它们对我们心理意味着什么。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到节目中。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到本播客。

sentences.en: New listeners, old listeners, wherever you are in the world, it is so great to have you here back for another episode as we, as always, break down the psychology of our 20s.
sentences.zh: 新听众、老听众，无论你身处世界的哪个角落，非常高兴你能回来收听新的一期节目，和往常一样，我们将剖析20多岁的心理学。

sentences.en: Today, we're going to have a bit more of a chit-chat, chill, sit down, and discuss episode, more of a casual episode, more of a personal episode today.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要进行一期更像闲聊、放松、坐下来探讨的节目，这是一期更随性、更个人的节目。

sentences.en: I like to do these every now and again.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢每隔一段时间就做一次这样的节目。

sentences.en: This podcast is kind of also a bit of a diary and a journal for me through my 20s, as much as I love the research and I love thinking about all the science.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，这个播客在某种程度上也是我20多岁时的日记和手账，尽管我热爱研究，也喜欢思考所有的科学原理。

sentences.en: I also like to be able to look back on the episodes that I've done in the past and kind of see where I was at in that moment.
sentences.zh: 我也希望能回看自己过去做过的节目，看看自己在那个时刻究竟处于怎样的状态。

sentences.en: And this episode is one of those.
sentences.zh: 而这期节目就是其中之一。

sentences.en: It's kind of a nice time, I think, to do a little check-in.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，现在正是做一个小总结的好时机。

sentences.en: The reason being is because I just turned 24.
sentences.zh: 原因在于，我刚满24岁。

sentences.en: I am sure there are a lot of people listening to this who are like, oh my gosh, you are such a baby.
sentences.zh: 我敢肯定，听这期节目的很多人心里都会想：天哪，你还是个小婴儿呢。

sentences.en: 24 years old, what are you talking about?
sentences.zh: 才24岁，你在说什么呢？

sentences.en: That is so young.
sentences.zh: 这太年轻了。

sentences.en: But in my eyes, obviously it's the oldest I've ever been, duh.
sentences.zh: 但在我眼里，这显然是我有生以来年纪最大的一次，废话。

sentences.en: But it's also really interesting because I view birthdays with such fear and such, just such anxiety.
sentences.zh: 但这也真的很有意思，因为我对生日总是怀有一种恐惧，甚至纯粹的焦虑。

sentences.en: And I think that that is a very common experience, this fear of getting older, this fear of having additional responsibilities, of realizing that time is finite
sentences.zh: 我想这是一种非常普遍的体验，对变老的恐惧，对承担更多责任的恐惧，对意识到时间是有限的恐惧，

sentences.en: and that you're kind of churning through the amount of years that you might have available on this earth.
sentences.zh: 以及意识到你在飞快消耗着你在这个地球上可能拥有的岁月。

sentences.en: I know it sounds very existential because it is.
sentences.zh: 我知道这听起来非常存在主义，因为它的确是。

sentences.en: And I remember being maybe like 16.
sentences.zh: 我还记得自己大概16岁的时候。

sentences.en: I have this very distinct memory of being around that age and thinking, oh my gosh, 24?
sentences.zh: 我有一个非常深刻的记忆，当时差不多那个年纪，心想：天哪，24岁？

sentences.en: That is so old.
sentences.zh: 那太老了。

sentences.en: That is so old.
sentences.zh: 那真的太老了。

sentences.en: People at that age must have everything together.
sentences.zh: 那个岁数的人一定把一切都安排得井井有条。

sentences.en: Like, I'm going to have a house at that age.
sentences.zh: 比如，到了那个年纪我肯定有自己的房子。

sentences.en: I'm going to have children.
sentences.zh: 我会拥有孩子。

sentences.en: I'm going to have my little pet dog or whatever it was.
sentences.zh: 我会养一只宠物狗，或者诸如此类的东西。

sentences.en: And here I am at that age now looking back at the vision that my younger self had and I'm just in a completely different place than I thought I would be.
sentences.zh: 而现在我到了这个年纪，回看年轻时的自己所设想的愿景，我发现自己所处的位置和我原本以为的完全不同。

sentences.en: And I don't know if it's just me, but I always find that birthdays are such a point of like reflection, but also anxiety anxiety because it really puts into perspective
sentences.zh: 我不知道是不是只有我这样，但我总是觉得生日是一个反思的节点，同时也是焦虑的节点，因为它真正让人看清了，

sentences.en: really how finite we, how much finite time we actually have on the earth and how much there is to do, how much there is to achieve, how much love there is to give
sentences.zh: 我们在地球上实际拥有的有限时间究竟有多少，还有多少事情要做，多少目标要实现，多少爱要去付出，

sentences.en: and the ways in which we might be wasting that time or not taking complete advantage of that.
sentences.zh: 以及我们在哪些方面可能正在浪费时间，或者没有完全充分利用这些时间。

sentences.en: So yes, that is a long ramble, but it was my birthday.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这是一番长篇大论，但我的生日过得很棒。

sentences.en: It was amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: I had a great time.
sentences.zh: 我玩得很开心。

sentences.en: Um,
sentences.zh: 嗯，

sentences.en: my boyfriend took me out for dinner and then I went out to dinner with a bunch of my friends and it's really nice to be around friends who have known you for a while
sentences.zh: 我男友带我出去吃晚餐，然后我和一群朋友也出去吃了晚餐，能和那些认识你挺久的朋友在一起，感觉真的很棒，

sentences.en: and also new friends, you know, people that I've known since high school and since literally my first day of uni and then people I only met last year and my partner
sentences.zh: 还有新朋友，你知道的，有我从高中就认识的人，有字面意义上大学第一天就认识的人，还有我去年才认识的人以及我的伴侣，

sentences.en: and it's just a very beautiful experience.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一次非常美好的体验。

sentences.en: I always try to make a big deal out of my birthday.
sentences.zh: 我总是试图把我的生日搞得轰轰烈烈。

sentences.en: If you know me personally, you're probably laughing at that statement because you know how true that is.
sentences.zh: 如果你私下认识我，你现在可能正在笑出声，因为你知道这有多真实。

sentences.en: For my 21st birthday, I think I tried to like distract myself from my fear of aging by just going all out.
sentences.zh: 在我21岁生日时，我想我大概是通过大肆庆祝来转移自己对衰老恐惧的注意力。

sentences.en: I had, it was literally the festival of Gemma.
sentences.zh: 那是字面意义上的杰玛狂欢节。

sentences.en: I had three birthday parties.
sentences.zh: 我办了三个生日派对。

sentences.en: It was a bit overkill, but I think in my mind, I was like, if I can make this exciting, maybe I can suppress some of the anxiety I have around my finite existence on this planet
sentences.zh: 这确实有点用力过猛，但在我当时的想法里，我觉得：如果我能把这办得激动人心，也许我就能压抑一些内心对于自己在这个星球上有限存在的焦虑，

sentences.en: and around the fact that I am getting older and I may not have achieved everything that I wanted to at this age.
sentences.zh: 以及对于我正在变老、可能无法在这个年纪实现我想要的一切这一事实的焦虑。

sentences.en: It's also inevitable that on every birthday I have, I always end up crying.
sentences.zh: 还有一个不可避免的情况是，在我过的每一个生日上，我最后总是会哭。

sentences.en: This year, I am proud to say I cried from a happy place, from a positive place.
sentences.zh: 今年，我很骄傲地说，我是因为快乐、因为积极的情绪而哭的。

sentences.en: I felt so loved, so surrounded by good people.
sentences.zh: 我感到自己被深深爱着，被美好的人们环绕着。

sentences.en: I think this is also one of the first times in my life that I've just felt true peace, peace with who I am, peace with where I'm at, peace with the people around me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这也是我生命中头几次感受到真正的平静，对自己感到平静，对自己的现状感到平静，对周围的人感到平静。

sentences.en: Once again, birthdays are such a point of reflection and I think back to where I was last year and the year before when I first moved to Sydney and I didn't have any friends
sentences.zh: 再说一次，生日真是一个反思的节点，我会回想起去年以及前年我刚搬到悉尼时自己还没有任何朋友的那个时候，

sentences.en: and the year before that when I was celebrating my first birthday after being through like a horrific breakup and not having this person that I'd been around for two years
sentences.zh: 以及更前一年，当时我经历了一场可怕的分手后庆祝自己的第一个生日，身边没有了那个陪伴了我两年的家伙，

sentences.en: and every point, every year is just kind of a further opportunity to really see how far I've come but then also how much is left in the future.
sentences.zh: 每一个节点、每一年都只是一种进一步的契机，让我真正看到自己走过了多远的路，同时也看到未来还有多少空间。

sentences.en: So let's talk about this fear of aging.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们来谈谈这种对衰老的恐惧吧。

sentences.en: If you can relate,
sentences.zh: 如果你能感同身受，

sentences.en: I'm sure there are many of you.
sentences.zh: 我相信你们当中有很多人都会有同感。

sentences.en: Why does it feel so oppressive and scary sometimes to acknowledge that we're getting older?
sentences.zh: 为什么有时候仅仅是承认我们在变老，都会让人觉得那么压抑和害怕？

sentences.en: For me, I think it's that birthdays symbolize being closer to death and it is very innate and natural as a human, as a mammal, as a species to fear death, to fear what that brings,
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我觉得是因为生日象征着离死亡更近了，而作为一个人类、作为一种哺乳动物、作为一个物种，害怕死亡、害怕死亡带来的一切，是极其本能且自然的，

sentences.en: the unknown.
sentences.zh: 也就是对未知的恐惧。

sentences.en: Of course, there are many people who have different conceptions and different ideas of what comes afterwards.
sentences.zh: 当然，有许多人对死后会发生什么有着不同的看法和观念。

sentences.en: For me, I don't think I really have one and so thinking about how each year represents less time to be alive, it also represents less time before the unknown and that's seriously
sentences.zh: 对我而言，我想我并没有一个确切的看法，所以每想到每过去一年意味着活在世上的时间变少，这也意味着距离未知更近了一步，这真的让我

sentences.en: what I'm probably most scared of.
sentences.zh: 感到最害怕的大概就是这个。

sentences.en: It's not that I'm scared of the added responsibility.
sentences.zh: 并不是说我害怕随之而来的责任。

sentences.en: I think it's not that I'm scared of growing up in the sense of giving up the younger versions of myself.
sentences.zh: 我觉得并不是害怕长大意味着要告别更年轻的自己。

sentences.en: There's a whole syndrome around that called Peter Pan syndrome, which basically talks about people who fight against growing older because they're scared
sentences.zh: 围绕这一点有一个专门的综合征叫做彼得·潘综合征，它基本上是指那些抗拒长大的人，因为他们害怕

sentences.en: of what it means to be an adult.
sentences.zh: 成为成年人意味着什么。

sentences.en: Specifically, they're scared of losing joy and wonder and a lack of responsibility and a lack of accountability.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，他们害怕失去快乐、惊奇感，害怕缺乏责任和问责。

sentences.en: That's a whole different episode, a whole different conversation.
sentences.zh: 那是完全不同的一集节目，完全不同的对话。

sentences.en: I don't think I necessarily have that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我未必有那种情况。

sentences.en: I think I recognize how much of a privilege it is to get older and what a privilege it is to age.
sentences.zh: 我认为我意识到了变老是一件多么特权的事情，老去是一种多么大的特权。

sentences.en: And I've always said that I think about all my friends who are in their 30s and they genuinely just get, their lives just seem to get better.
sentences.zh: 我一直都说，我想象着我所有三十多岁的朋友们，他们的生活真的只是在变得更好。

sentences.en: They get hotter.
sentences.zh: 他们变得更有魅力了。

sentences.en: They get more successful.
sentences.zh: 他们变得更成功了。

sentences.en: They have more money.
sentences.zh: 他们更有钱了。

sentences.en: They have more fun.
sentences.zh: 他们过得更开心了。

sentences.en: They have more freedom, it seems to me.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，他们拥有了更多自由。

sentences.en: They really know themselves more.
sentences.zh: 他们真正更了解自己了。

sentences.en: So I'm excited for that.
sentences.zh: 所以我对此感到兴奋。

sentences.en: I'm excited for my 30s.
sentences.zh: 我为自己的三十多岁感到兴奋。

sentences.en: I'm excited for my 40s and my 50s.
sentences.zh: 我为自己的四十多岁和五十多岁感到兴奋。

sentences.en: My mom seems like she's having an amazing time.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈看起来就过得非常开心。

sentences.en: Those new chapters are thrilling to me and I think that there used to be such a sense of like your 20s are the best years of your life.
sentences.zh: 那些新的篇章对我有极大的吸引力，而且我觉得过去曾有一种观念，认为20多岁是你一生中最美好的年华。

sentences.en: When those are done,
sentences.zh: 一旦这些年华结束了，

sentences.en: everything else is a wasteland, like there's nothing left afterwards.
sentences.zh: 其他一切就都是一片荒漠，仿佛后面就什么都不剩了。

sentences.en: That is a massive misconception.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的误区。

sentences.en: Obviously, I talk about our 20s twice a week, all the time, everywhere I go, but I really don't think that your life ends the moment you turn 30.
sentences.zh: 当然，我每周两次都在谈论我们的20多岁，无时无刻不在谈，走到哪里都谈，但我真的不认为你的生命会在你满30岁的那一刻结束。

sentences.en: There is a recognition that there is a lot of beauty and grace and excitement in aging, but it's that catch-22 of realizing that the more you grow into yourself, the more versions
sentences.zh: 人们渐渐意识到，衰老之中其实蕴含着许多美丽、优雅和激动人心之处，但这也伴随着一种两难困境：你越是成长为真正的自己，你就要向越多的过往版本

sentences.en: you have to say goodbye to and the less time you have in front of you.
sentences.zh: 挥手道别，并且你面前拥有的时间也越来越少。

sentences.en: I think it's that mortality alarm, that inbuilt mortality alarm that we all have, that we all, that we have as mammals, as a species that realizes how fragile life is,
sentences.zh: 我想，那是我们的死亡警报，是我们所有人、我们作为哺乳动物和物种所内置的死亡警报，它开始意识到生命是多么脆弱，

sentences.en: that starts to really sound off and blare every birthday because it's a significant kind of triggering event or like anniversary of acknowledgement of birth and death
sentences.zh: 并在每个生日时真正拉响并发出刺耳的警报，因为这是一个意义重大的触发事件，或是对生与死以及

sentences.en: and how they're very like interlinked.
sentences.zh: 它们如何紧密相连的一种周年纪念式的认知。

sentences.en: I know that sounds very deeply philosophical, but I have honestly thought about this so much.
sentences.zh: 我知道这听起来极其哲学，但我老实说真的思考过很多次。

sentences.en: I also think that another factor around this like fear of aging thing is that birthdays make us very conscious of time passing.
sentences.zh: 我还认为，关于这种对衰老恐惧的另一个因素是，生日让我们对时间的流逝变得高度敏感。

sentences.en: When I was a kid, even a teenager, that used to really, really scare me because it felt like something I could not control.
sentences.zh: 当我还是个孩子，甚至还是个青少年的时候，这真的、真的很吓唬我，因为它感觉像是一件我无法控制的事情。

sentences.en: Time, this like weird entity that none of us can really visualize, it was just slipping away from me and I wasn't able to do anything about it and I would sit and I would spiral
sentences.zh: 时间，这个我们谁都无法真正具象化的奇怪实体，就这样从我指缝中溜走，而我却无能为力，我会坐着胡思乱想，

sentences.en: and I would think about it and I would, I remember distinctly watching this bird at my window when I was in university fluttering and every time it fluttered from one side
sentences.zh: 沉浸在焦虑的漩涡中，我清晰地记得当我在上大学时，看着窗户边的一只鸟在扑腾翅膀，每当它从一边扑腾到

sentences.en: to the other I was like that's a second gone, that's another second gone, that's a second gone, like time is just rolling on and on and on and it feels like this freight train
sentences.zh: 另一边时，我就想：那过去了一秒钟，又过去了一秒钟，又过去了一秒钟，时间就这样不断地向前滚呀滚呀滚，感觉它就像一列货运列车，

sentences.en: that's just going to destroy everything in its path and eventually it's going to destroy me.
sentences.zh: 即将摧毁它路径上的一切，最终也将摧毁我。

sentences.en: There's a lot of fear there.
